table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Type = 'GATE PASS',
	ReferenceNO = 'FMM-GPD-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode, 10))), 
	MotorVehicle = (SELECT M.Name FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	ChasisNo = (SELECT M.ChasisNo FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	EngineNo = (SELECT M.EngineNo FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	Color = (SELECT M.Color FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	Model = (SELECT M.Model FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	Area = (SELECT M.Area FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	EnginePower = (SELECT M.EnginePower FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	ToolKit = (SELECT M.ToolKit FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	SpareTyre = (SELECT M.SpareTyre FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	OriginalKeys = (SELECT M.OriginalKeys FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	WarrantyBook = (SELECT M.WarrantyBook FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	RegNo = (SELECT M.RegNo FROM MotorVehicle M WHERE M.MotorVehicleCode = issueheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	CustomerName = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = issueheader.AccCode),
	FatherName = (SELECT C.Fname FROM Customer C WHERE C.CustCode = issueheader.AccCode),
	CNIC = (SELECT C.NIC FROM Customer C WHERE C.CustCode = issueheader.AccCode),
	Phone = (SELECT C.Phone FROM Customer C WHERE C.CustCode = issueheader.AccCode),
	Address1 = (SELECT C.Address1 FROM Customer C WHERE C.CustCode = issueheader.AccCode),
	Address2 = (SELECT C.Address2 FROM Customer C WHERE C.CustCode = issueheader.AccCode),

	itemname= item.name,  
	itemaliasname=item.customicode,
	recipient = Case RecipientCode When 1 Then (Select Name From Department Where DeptCode=issueheader.deptcode) When 2 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = issueheader.AccCode) When 3 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = issueheader.AccCode) When 4 Then (Select Name From SalesMan Where SalesManCode = issueheader.RecipientSalesMan ) End,
	salesman = dbo.users.username, 
	issueinvcode = dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode, 
	smanname=(SELECT salesman.name FROM SalesMan WHERE SalesMan.SalesManCode = IssueHeader.SMANCode),
	date = dbo.issueheader.date,
	price = issuedetail.price,
	dbo.issueheader.deptcode,
	dbo.issueheader.remarks,	
	gcode = issuedetail.gcode,   
	icode = issuedetail.icode,   
	batch = issuedetail.batch,   
	expiry = issuedetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = issuedetail.qty,
	referenceno2=ISNULL((select name from issuetype where issuetypecode = issueheader.issuetypecode), '') + CASE issueheader.issuetypecode WHEN NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END + dbo.issueheader.referenceno,
	dbo.issueheader.referencedate,
	Godown = Godown.name,
	itempacking = itempacking.name,
	Id       = dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL 
FROM 
	issueheader, 
	issuedetail, 
	users, 
	item 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Godown ON (dbo.item.gcode = dbo.Godown.gcode)	
WHERE 
	( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = :ar_issueInvCode ) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
	( dbo.issuedetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)
ORDER BY 
	Type,
	dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL
